record.paper_title: Some open problems in Banach space theory
record.original_question: Is the Hilbert space ℓ₂ uniformly homeomorphic to a bounded subset of itself?

evidence.quote:
(Q.14) Is the Hilbert space l2 uniformly homeomorphic to a bounded subset of 
self ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\ell_2$ denote the separable real Hilbert space of square-summable sequences $x=(x_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ with norm $\|x\|_2=\big(\sum_{n=1}^\infty x_n^2\big)^{1/2}$ and the induced metric $d(x,y)=\|x-y\|_2$. A map $f:(M,d_M)\to(N,d_N)$ between metric spaces is a uniform homeomorphism if it is a bijection and both $f$ and $f^{-1}$ are uniformly continuous. A subset $B\subseteq\ell_2$ is bounded if $\sup_{x\in B}\|x\|_2<\infty$. 

Question: Does there exist a bounded subset $B\subseteq\ell_2$ such that $\ell_2$ is uniformly homeomorphic to $B$ (with the metric inherited from $\ell_2$)?
artifact.status_search_result: A theorem of Aharoni–Maurey–Mityagin shows that $\ell_p$ for $2<p<\infty$ is not uniformly homeomorphic to any bounded subset of itself, answering negatively the analogous question for those spaces. However, the case of $\ell_2$ specifically (which embeds linearly into $L_0$ and so is not excluded by that criterion) does not appear to be settled by the sources found, and the question is commonly listed as open in the Banach-space-theory problem literature.

status_evidence.title: Uniform embeddings of metric spaces and of Banach spaces into Hilbert spaces
status_evidence.snippet: A normed space is uniformly homeomorphic to a subset of Hilbert space iff it is linearly isomorphic to a subspace of L_0; in particular l_p (2<p<infty) is not uniformly embedded in a bounded subset of itself.
status_evidence.claim: The analogous question is settled negatively for l_p with p>2, but the criterion does not exclude l_2.

status_evidence.title: An introduction to the Ribe program (A. Naor)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of uniform homeomorphisms and embedding problems for Banach spaces, including questions about Hilbert space.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys uniform-homeomorphism problems concerning ell_2 within the Ribe program.
